scope: CPU-only offline full/half decay model evaluation from direct-mdst-tree-v4 preprocessed training input

validation.notebook_collection_blocker: optional nbformat is absent from the active environment

items.title: Promoted manifest/index binding
items.evidence: Evaluation binds schema, feature/PID contracts, target policy, selection-manifest hash, index hash, source groups, normalizers, and split; the promoted index has 35000 train and 50000 validation UIDs.
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Keep manifest and index immutable and publish both hashes with every HPO result.

items.title: Source-role index cannot use raw Parquet paths
items.evidence: Stable rehash disagreed with promoted source roles for 7 of 17 sources. load_dataset_index_metadata authenticates only index JSON object/version/index_hash and selection-contract schema/mode/hash fields, without path canonicalization, selection fingerprint recomputation, shard stat/open, sidecars, or source verification. Evaluator and shared loader then authenticate the supplied manifest JSON/hash before full loading; raw lists, raw Parquet, and wrong manifests fail metadata-only.
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Retain the shared fail-closed manifest requirement for every caller.

items.title: Split override precedence
items.evidence: Assignment order is event override, source-role override, then stable hash; evaluated UIDs are unique, outside train, and in the requested split.
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Retain the fail-closed checks.

items.title: Deterministic checkpoint validation cohort
items.evidence: Validation auto restores the ordered 1000-UID checkpoint rollout cohort from its deterministic 2000-event selection, validates manifest identity, and records exact UIDs plus digest; smoke selected the stored first UID.
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Use checkpoint cohort mode for ranking and label stream mode diagnostic.

items.title: No test role in promoted index
items.evidence: The promoted train_035k complete_only index contains train and validation only; --split test fails closed.
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Materialize a separate immutable test-role manifest/index after validation policy freeze.

items.title: Collation, padding, shapes, and dtypes
items.evidence: Event order is preserved and padding uses batch maxima; projection requires exact ranks and native widths: feature/availability blocks [B,N,W] with common 12, track 16, ECL/KLM 9 and composite 13, PID histogram [B,N,41], scalar masks/IDs [B,N], p4 [B,N,4], adjacency [B,N,N], and provenance [B,N,S>0]; float32/bool/int64 are enforced.
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Keep tensor validation at the evaluator boundary.

items.title: CLI remains batch-size one
items.evidence: Projection and rollout accept B>1, but evaluate_full_decay.py collates and reconstructs one event per call.
tests: lower-level batched parity tests; end-to-end evaluator tests are B=1
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Add a two-event unequal-FSP parity test before exposing CPU batch size.

items.title: Detector-FSP-only model input
items.evidence: Only active level-zero track/ECL/KLM rows are physically gathered; stored composites and all truth topology/PID/B-side/geometry fields are reset or removed. Real smoke passed 31 FSPs and discarded all 5 higher nodes.
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Never weaken projection; add every future truth-only field to its scrub audit.

items.title: Topology identity is separate from detector-resource provenance
items.evidence: Unique FSP keys and adjacency define topology; multi-hot detector provenance only defines source conflicts.
tests: detector conflict and topology-key separation regressions
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Preserve the two namespaces.

items.title: Evaluation keys never enter model dictionaries
items.evidence: evaluation_leaf_source_keys is carried beside FSPProjection and attached only after all model calls.
tests: scripted model records absence of evaluation metadata on every call
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Retain the side-channel boundary.

items.title: Forest-root-only daughters and exclusivity
items.evidence: Decode and append accept only unparented roots, enforce one parent, and reject detector-source reuse even without cardinality decoding. Because Track-A scheduled training uses the shared level-rollout implementation, its historical scheduled-training semantics and predicted_edge_f1 are also stale after this policy correction.
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Re-evaluate compared checkpoints; do not compare historical predicted_edge_f1 directly.

items.title: Empty-level continuation
items.evidence: Offline policy continues through empty eligible generations and reports counts; generic training rollout keeps stop-on-empty default. Policy version is fsp-forest-root-empty-level-soft-type-pid-parity-v2.
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Adopt only through a new explicit HPO rollout contract.

items.title: PID mode and pre-decoder type-policy parity
items.evidence: soft_decision_hard_construction uses soft_expectation inside the model and hard PID for persistent construction; serialized allowed mask, empirical soft bias, and pointer validity are injected before the decoder and affect expected type and pointer logits. Evaluation restores the model PID mode from authoritative feature_contract.pid_reconstruction_mode, treats an explicit config null as inheritance, rejects conflicting non-null config, and reports the instantiated model's actual mode.
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Supersede pre-v2 offline reports and rerun all candidates.

items.title: Full-root semantics
items.evidence: Full scope requires one explicit top-level Upsilon token 1 and never guesses a largest root; one eligible event is one trial.
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Keep root availability distinct from model success.

items.title: Two unordered B halves
items.evidence: Signal half scope contributes exactly two canonical multiplicity-one B rows; one-to-one source assignment excludes PID/p4 and counts extra predictions.
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Require assignment parity for optimizations.

items.title: Continuum component multiplicity
items.evidence: Continuum half scope emits one row per explicit top-level truth composite and no artificial hemispheres or both-halves trial; missing roots are unavailable and extra predicted components are counted.
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Version any future hemisphere label as a separate truth-only contract.

items.title: Direct-target representability denominator
items.evidence: An eligible root with an ineligible direct intermediate or detector conflict remains an available failed primary trial with target_representable=0; contracted_diagnostic is non-primary and mother metrics include only policy-eligible targets.
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Retrain/version contracted targets if desired; never use diagnostic contraction to improve current primary denominators.

items.title: LCAG and missing-particle topology
items.evidence: LCAG is source-keyed and order/ID/PID invariant; perfect also requires exact sources and valid tree; strict missing-one and induced leave-one-out report eligibility and omitted source.
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Aggregate sufficient-statistic numerators/denominators, not filtered means.

items.title: PID alignment and coverage
items.evidence: Leaf PID is source-keyed; mothers align by exact clade, induced height, and immediate child clades before conditional accuracy; root, coverage, availability, and confusion are separate.
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Keep PID out of alignment costs.

items.title: Momentum metrics are not physical resolution
items.evidence: Bias/MAE/RMSE, p3, relative momentum, mass, and coverage are source/topology aligned, but truth and prediction are reconstructed-FSP daughter sums; report sets physical_momentum_error_available=false. Closure is eligible only at denominator>0 and event/aggregate values are null rather than perfect at denominator zero.
tests: zero-denominator event and aggregate p4 closure
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Add evaluation-only MC-composite p4 in a future schema and scrub it before inference.

items.title: Rollout event validity
items.evidence: event_valid_mask now recomputes final acyclic, single-parent, level, and source validity rather than initial non-emptiness; runner independently recomputes validity and closure.
tests: malformed topology and focused rollout diagnostics
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Keep both rollout and runner validity in receipts.

items.title: Actual checkpoint pair
items.evidence: Feature/model/PID contracts match and 121/121 transferred encoder tensors are key-, shape-, dtype-, and bit-exact; equal-valued tensors of different dtype fail closed and dtype-compatible key count is reported. Checkpoint SHA-256 and steps are frozen above.
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Fail closed unless an explicitly disclosed fine-tuned encoder is intended.

items.title: Model restoration API and tensor shapes
items.evidence: Strict architecture/normalizer/policy/PID restoration on CPU eval; actual model d_model=128, hyper_dim=32, Q=32, cardinality=16, PID=41; outputs object/confidence [B,Q], type [B,Q,41], pointer [B,Q,N], cardinality [B,Q,C+1].
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Require checkpoint migration tests for API changes.

items.title: Missing contract identifiers
items.evidence: Standalone pair validation requires nonempty feature/model/PID identifiers before equality, so two missing contracts cannot compare equal.
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Retain nonempty checks.

items.title: Learned-confidence default
items.evidence: Default comes from checkpoint_selection_contract and is true for the actual checkpoint; CLI overrides are labeled diagnostic and reported.
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Use the checkpoint default for rankings and never combine override results.

items.title: Evaluator code provenance
items.evidence: Reports bind current HEAD to a SHA-256 over raw git ls-files -s -z index metadata plus cached diff bytes. The worktree must equal the index; untracked names are listed without reading their payloads and make provenance incomplete. Current official candidate remains uncommitted.
tests: real report provenance block is stale pending clean-commit rerun
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Commit/freeze evaluator code before a publication or final HPO table.

items.title: CPU/GPU training isolation
items.evidence: CUDA is hidden before torch import, checkpoints map to CPU, model must already be CPU/eval, workers are zero, and threads are bounded; no GPU compute process or training state was touched.
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Keep evaluation in a separate CPU process.

items.title: Repeated index/checkpoint loading
items.evidence: Index/shard verification and reconstruction checkpoint loading are repeated; final smoke used 141.23 s for context load versus 6.45 s for two-scope inference.
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Pass one verified index payload and loaded checkpoint payload through the pipeline.

items.title: Duplicate full/half rollout
items.evidence: --scope both performs separate full and half rollouts although most decoding is shared.
tests: semantic parity exists; compute-reuse parity does not
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Derive both views from one max-level rollout and prove identical outputs.

items.title: Padded query growth and dense closure
items.evidence: Every level appends Q=32 slots including rejected padding, approaching N_FSP+8Q width; transitive closure loops total_count times over dense boolean matrix products.
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Compact accepted slots and update tree closure incrementally before large samples or batching.

items.title: Timing, provenance, and atomic report write
items.evidence: Report carries stage timing/throughput, policy/configuration, UIDs, structural counters, index-bound code provenance, and strict finite JSON. Publication uses tempfile.mkstemp exclusive creation in output.parent, writes/flushes/fsyncs the returned descriptor, atomically replaces the destination, and cleans up only its owned temporary.
tests: real smoke is stale pending clean-commit rerun
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Optionally add a detached artifact SHA-256 sidecar in publication automation.

items.title: Output cannot alias a read input
items.evidence: Before any checkpoint/data loading, --output is resolved and compared with direct inputs plus manifest shard/sidecar/marker paths; path equality, symlinks, and hardlinks fail closed. Report publication cannot follow or truncate predictable legacy temporary symlink/hardlink aliases because it exclusively creates an owned random temporary.
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Reuse this preflight in future evaluation scripts that atomically replace outputs.

items.title: Duplicate channel-memory migration receipt
items.evidence: restore_training_checkpoint appends empty_channel_memory_expansion_v1 and then re-extends the same migrations list, yielding a duplicate receipt; file was untouched by this task.
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Append the channel-memory migration exactly once using a separate local variable.

items.title: Phase-3 authorization runtime hash drift
items.evidence: Authorization binds runtime-contract SHA 411facd..., current tracked runtime-contract file is ed1a1d...; four tests fail before preflight checks. No Slurm material or job state was changed.
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Re-materialize authorization through its owner workflow; do not hand-edit hashes here.

items.title: Notebook optional dependency missing
items.evidence: The active virtual environment lacks nbformat, so two notebook-only suites cannot collect.
tests: pytest collection error for the two notebook suites
items.smallest_safe_upstream_action: Run notebook tests in the declared notebook-extra environment.
